description: This file defines a tool for executing HTTP GET requests, including schema creation for query parameters, request handling, and URL construction with support for path and query parameters.

classes.name: RequestsGetTool
classes.description: A class extending DynamicStructuredTool to perform configurable GET requests with dynamic URL and query parameter handling.

methods.name: createRequestsGetSchema
methods.description: Creates a Zod schema for GET request query parameters based on an optional JSON schema string.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Performs the GET request, constructing URL with path and query parameters, and returns the response text truncated to maxOutputLength.
